_note: 도감 (field guide) pages of the animal scene (Prompt 9f): meeting the need of an endangered or extinct kind adds its page to the 수첩 once per hike (animals.dogam). Each page is one note with the 'field_guide' style from its first line on; the first line is the title. This file sorts before hallasan.json, so the exit notes stay the newest pages.

notes.text:
노루 · Roe deer
Nearly wiped out on Jeju in the 1980s. Then there were too many.
Jeju called them pests and culled 7,032 between 2013 and 2019.
Eats 콩 and 고구마, preferably yours. Males drop their antlers in autumn.

비바리뱀 · Bibari snake
In Korea, found only on Jeju. Class I endangered.
Eats lizards. Extremely shy. Please do not step on it.

검독수리 · Golden eagle
Class I endangered. A nest was confirmed near Hallasan
for the first time in 77 years. Sees you before you see it.

고라니 · Water deer
Extinct on Hallasan. Vulnerable worldwide.
Males grow long fangs. It screams. You'd scream too.

사슴 · Deer
The native deer is gone from Hallasan.
Deer released in the 1990s now push out the 노루.
Nobody asked the 노루.
